entities.name: Query CutC protein
observations: 248 aa bacterial protein with exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Citrobacter koseri CutC protein A8AFG8.

Closest reviewed homologs are annotated as cytoplasmic and copper ion-binding; E. coli homologs are homodimers.
